name: Contact book (teaching example)
description: Owner-only exact-byte contact names mapped to an AccountID.
readme:
## Trigger
Owner self-Invoke, Destination omitted. Parameters: op=01, name=1..28 non-NUL UTF-8 bytes for generated clients, addr=20 raw AccountID bytes. C treats name bytes as opaque; no Unicode normalization.

## State
The installation namespace stores keys CTCT + name + right zero padding to 32 bytes. Data is version 01 followed by the 20-byte AccountID. The explorer key column keeps NUL padding, including CSV exports. This ABI describes state only; it does not sign Invoke or establish ownership.

## Verification
Use check.json synthetic fixtures and inspect decoded values; test every real record kind and the full installed namespace inventory before publishing for the actual HookHash.
